The controller turns that shape into application calls: it converts `from` to a Date and passes the values to ReserveSpotService.reserve, and it calls CancelReservation.cancel with the id. It returns either the application receipt or a simple acknowledgement object. It holds no business rule: no domain invariant, pricing or availability calculation, and no decision the domain or application layer should own. Both constructor parameters are application types, a layer adapters-inbound may depend on, so they are dependency wiring. Injecting the concrete service instead of a port is a dependency-direction or design-style point, not a responsibility in the wrong layer. No deterministic checks flagged anything.
